name: DeBess
purpose: De-esser that detects 's' sounds by their waveform rather than a frequency band, so it reduces sibilance while leaving the rest of the treble untouched.
avoid_for: dynamic (moving-coil) mic recordings with dull top end

expose.ai_hint: Amount of de-essing. 0 is off; raise until harsh esses soften.
Width of the ess-detection window; higher isolates esses more strictly.
How far detected esses are reduced.

hidden_reason: Control E (Sense) is a monitor switch: 0.5 and above outputs only the removed esses (DeBessProc.cpp). Kept at 0, normal output.
notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Hints are first drafts and need refining in listening tests.
Airwindopedia notes DeBess may not engage on prosumer interfaces or moving-coil mics whose top end is dull. Add a conventional frequency-band de-esser as a fallback for those recordings.
CPU: 0.95% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
